name: Ascent Watch: Your HelixCorp Community Digest
description: A hyperlocal community broadcast distributed to HelixCorp residential compounds and affiliated Tier 2-3 neighborhoods, Ascent Watch presents itself as a community news program — featuring resident spotlights, infrastructure updates, and wellness segments — while systematically reframing every item of negative news as evidence of why corponation membership is the only rational response to an unstable world. The show has a different host in every district, giving it an authentic local texture that makes its ideological architecture nearly invisible.
cultural_impact: Ascent Watch's distributed local-host model has been studied and replicated by three other corponations, effectively industrializing the format of hyperlocal propaganda as a community service.
story_hooks: A local Ascent Watch host contacts the party in secret — they were hired as a genuine community broadcaster and have only recently understood what the show actually is
The party needs to insert a piece of real information into an Ascent Watch broadcast to reach residents of a specific compound who have no other outside media access

HelixCorp's Ascent Watch archive contains years of hyperlocal footage that incidentally documents infrastructure, security rotations, and resident movement patterns — making it an intelligence goldmine
